name: frijolito
description: Ask Frijolito, file and follow requests with the team, and verify signed receipts. Verifying needs no account and no key.

api_key.title: Receipt API key
api_key.description: Optional. Only needed to notarize. Asking, requests and verifying work without it. Request one from concierge@frijolito.app (fj_test_… or fj_live_…).

allow_live.title: Allow production receipts
allow_live.description: Turn on to let an fj_live_ key mint production receipts. Leave off while testing.

hook_key.title: Hook receipt key
hook_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep hook receipts off. With a key (fjh_test_… or fjh_live_…), each Bash, Edit, Write and MCP call in Claude Code leaves a signed, self-reported receipt. Frijolito keeps hashes and a one-line summary, not the call's input or result.
